summary_en: This study tests trastuzumab deruxtecan (T-DXd) with immunotherapy drugs, with or without chemotherapy, as first-line treatment for advanced or metastatic non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer with HER2 overexpression. All study drugs are given as an IV infusion, and how often and for how long is not stated. The main goal is to measure safety and tolerability, and this is a Phase 1 (Phase Ib) study where efficacy is a secondary measure.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa trastuzumab deruxtecan (T-DXd) con medicamentos de inmunoterapia, con o sin quimioterapia, como tratamiento de primera línea para el cáncer de pulmón de células no pequeñas avanzado o metastásico, no escamoso, con sobreexpresión de HER2. Todos los medicamentos del estudio se administran por infusión intravenosa, y no se indica con qué frecuencia ni durante cuánto tiempo. El objetivo principal es medir la seguridad y la tolerabilidad, y es un estudio de fase 1 (fase Ib) en el que la eficacia es una medida secundaria.
who_for: Unresectable locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer
HER2 overexpression confirmed by central review of tumor tissue
Age 18 or older; some parts require body weight of at least 35 kg
not_for: Current or past non-infectious interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis needing steroids
Known HIV, or active hepatitis B or C with the stated conditions
Active infection, including tuberculosis, needing IV treatment
Untreated, symptomatic brain metastases or spinal cord compression
Prior anti-PD-1, anti-PD-L1, anti-CTLA-4 or anti-TIGIT therapy (for some parts)
